settlement_rule: A game is FINAL only when the official NBA game page shows 'Final' (or 'Final/OT') AND the gamebook PDF prints a FINAL line whose four quarters sum to it. Both conditions are checked in scripts/build_results_feed.py and the per-row 'verified' flag records the outcome.
notes: Statuses 'Final' and the final scores were read twice from official pages: the scoreboard (https://www.nba.com/games?date=2026-11-15) and each game's summary page, both read 2026-11-15 ~23:49-23:59Z; each final also appears on the other game's summary sidebar.

Quarter lines are taken from the official gamebook PDF's 'SCORE BY PERIOD' table (transcribed verbatim in data/live/raw/gamebook_20261115_INDPHI.md and _LALPHX.md). The scoreboard view fetched here does not print quarter lines, so no second quarter-line source is claimed: the builder checks the gamebook's printed FINAL against the sum of its printed quarters AND against the game-page final.
Tip times, venues and pre-game records come from the committed official schedule capture data/app/official_slate_1115_1118.json (nba.com/schedule?date=2026-11-15) and the games pages.
